articles.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
articles.description: Stablecoins lead instruments in use or planned at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits at 53% and tokenized money market funds at 52%.

articles.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules
articles.description: Itaú Unibanco notified Brazil’s central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations on Tuesday, ahead of an Oct. 30 deadline.

articles.title: Kospi surges 7% as SK Hynix earnings fuel AI stock rebound

articles.title: Here's how much bitcoin and the S&P 500 could rally after midterms
articles.description: Both bitcoin and the S&P 500 have historically produced positive returns in a year after midterms. BTC's pattern, however, could also be explained by the four-year halving cycles.

articles.title: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain as institutional tokenization gathers steam
articles.description: The firms announced the agreement at Meridian 2026, the Stellar Development Foundation’s annual conference in Portugal.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
articles.description: The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

articles.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
articles.description: The breach hit an internal employee system that Bithumb says is separate from its trading platform, while the exchange is still determining whether customer information was exposed.
